items.docs: Enables you to follow or unfollow a rule.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve rules.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of rules to retrieve on each page.

params.name: source
params.description: Pass a comma-separated list of source IDs to filter rules.

params.name: created_by_id
params.description: Pass the ID of the creator of the rules to filter.

params.name: status
params.description: Pass the status of the rules. By default, rules with all statuses are retrieved.

params.name: last_active_to
params.description: Pass the last active time in epoch format to filter rules.

params.name: last_active_from
params.description: Pass the last active time in epoch format to filter rules.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Pass the creation time in epoch format to filter rules.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Pass the creation time in epoch format to filter rules.

params.name: is_manual_run
params.description: Pass true to retrieve rules that are configured for manual execution only.
